roots.origin: 拉丁语 gradus / gradi（一步、走）
roots.core_concept: a step, to step / 一步一步地走
roots.core_image: 台阶一级一级往上，每次只抬一只脚
roots.english_definition: a step, a degree, to walk

roots.core_concept: to pour out / 倒出去、化开
roots.core_image: 一壶水倒进盆里，水面立刻铺满整个盆底

roots.core_concept: to choose what one wants / 挑出自己想要的那个
roots.core_image: 菜单上手指停在一行，就点这个

roots.core_concept: a citizen, one who lives under shared rules / 按共同规矩相处的城中人
roots.core_image: 街市上互不相识的人靠同一套规矩打交道，不动手

concepts.core_image: 台阶一级一级往上，每次只抬一只脚
一壶水倒进盆里，水面立刻铺满盆底
菜单上手指停在一行，就点这个
街市上互不相识的人靠同一套规矩打交道

words.root_logic: gradus（一步、一级）本身即词根，无词缀 → 阶梯上的某一级，即所处的那一档
words.recall_hint: gradus（一步、一级）本身即词根 → 阶梯上的某一级，即所处的那一档：分数、年级、坡度都是
words.native_definition: a level of quality or rank, a school year, or a slope
words.core_concept: one step on a scale – 阶梯上的某一级
words.core_image: 台阶从下往上编号，站在第几级一目了然
examples: She got the highest grade in the class.
He teaches fourth grade.
The road has a steep grade here.
semantic_expansions: 等级/分数：阶梯上的那一级
年级：学制阶梯上的那一级
坡度：路面每步抬升的那个量。四义共享'阶梯上的一级'

words.root_logic: grad（一步）+ -ual（…的）→ 一步一步来的 → 逐渐的
words.native_definition: happening slowly over a period of time
words.core_concept: advancing one step at a time – 一步一步地推进，不跳跃
words.core_image: 水位每天涨一指，看一天看不出，看一月很明显
examples: There has been a gradual improvement.
The slope is long but gradual.
semantic_expansions: 逐渐的与渐进的：都是'一步一步来、不跳跃'，中文两种说法同一个节奏

words.root_logic: up-（向上）+ grade（一级）→ 往上抬一级 → 升级
words.origin: 英语 up + 拉丁语 gradus（等级）
words.native_definition: to raise something to a higher level or better standard
words.core_concept: moving something up a step – 把它往上抬一级
words.core_image: 机票从后排换到前舱，位置往上挪了一档
examples: We upgraded the software last night.
She was upgraded to business class.
semantic_expansions: 升级/提升：往上抬一级
升舱：座位往上挪一档。同一个'上抬一级'，抬的是版本还是位置

words.root_logic: ag-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ gress（grad 的变体，走）+ -ive → 朝人步步逼近的 → 好斗的
words.recall_hint: ag-（朝向）+ gress（走）+ -ive → 朝对方步步逼近的；用在做法上则是进逼式的、不留余地
words.origin: 拉丁语 aggressivus：ad-（朝向）+ gradi（走）——'走向、进逼'
words.native_definition: ready to attack or confront, or forceful in pursuing aims
words.core_concept: stepping toward another to press on them – 一步步朝对方逼过去
words.core_image: 对面的人每说一句就往前迈半步，人只能后退
examples: The dog became aggressive when cornered.
They took an aggressive approach to sales.
semantic_expansions: 好斗的/有攻击性的：朝人步步逼近
积极进取的（商业）：做法上步步进逼，不留余地。同一个'向前进逼'，褒贬随场合而变

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ fuse（倒）→ 几样东西倒在一起分不开 → 使混乱
words.origin: 拉丁语 confundere：com-（一起）+ fundere（倒出）
words.native_definition: to make someone unable to think clearly, or to mistake one thing for another
words.core_concept: pouring things together until they cannot be told apart – 倒在一起，分不出哪是哪
words.core_image: 两种颜料倒进同一个碗，搅完谁也捞不出来
examples: The signs only confused drivers.
People often confuse the two brothers.
semantic_expansions: 弄糊涂：把人脑中的东西搅在一起
混淆：把两样东西倒在一起分不清。同一个'倒在一起难分'，搅的是人还是事物

words.root_logic: dif-（dis- 的变体，四散）+ fuse（倒）→ 往四面倒开 → 扩散
words.origin: 拉丁语 diffundere：dis-（四散）+ fundere（倒出）
words.native_definition: to spread out over a wide area, or to make light softer
words.core_concept: pouring outward in all directions – 朝四面倒开、铺散
words.core_image: 一滴墨落进水里，颜色从中心朝各方向散开
examples: The scent diffused through the room.
A screen diffuses the lamplight.
semantic_expansions: 扩散/散播：朝四面倒开铺散
使柔和（光线）：把光散开不再集中。同一个'四散倒开'，散的是气味还是光

words.root_logic: fundere（倒出、熔化）本身即词根，无前缀 → 熔到一起成为一体；名词指熔断保护的那根丝
words.recall_hint: fundere（熔化、倒出）本身即词根 → 熔到一起成为一体；名词指电流过大时会先熔断的那根丝
words.native_definition: to join into one by melting, or a safety device that melts to break a circuit
words.core_concept: melting two things into one – 熔到一起成为一体
words.core_image: 两段铁在炉火里烧红后压合，冷却后看不出接缝
examples: The two companies fused into one group.
The fuse blew during the storm.
semantic_expansions: 熔合/融合：熔到一起成为一体
保险丝：会先熔断的那根丝。同一个'熔'，一个是合一个是断

words.root_logic: re-（往回）+ fuse（倒）→ 把递来的倒回去 → 拒绝
words.origin: 拉丁语 refundere：re-（往回）+ fundere（倒出）——'倒回去'
words.native_definition: to say no to something offered or requested
words.core_concept: pouring back what was offered – 把递过来的原样倒回去
words.core_image: 对方倒过来的茶被推回去，杯子原样送还
examples: She refused the offer without hesitating.
He refused to answer the question.
semantic_expansions: 拒绝与谢绝：都是'把递来的倒回去'，中文按客气程度分了两个词

words.root_logic: optare（选择）本身即词根，无词缀 → 在几个之中挑定自己要的那个
words.native_definition: to choose one thing rather than another
words.core_concept: settling on the one you want – 在几个之中挑定要的那个
words.core_image: 表格上三个方框，只在其中一个里打勾
examples: Most staff opted for the earlier shift.
She opted to study abroad.
semantic_expansions: 选择与抉择：都是'在几个之中挑定要的那个'，中文按分量轻重分了两个词

words.root_logic: opt（选择）+ -ion（名词）→ 可供挑选的那一项 → 选项
words.native_definition: one of the things that can be chosen, or the freedom to choose
words.core_concept: one of the things open to be chosen – 摆出来供人挑的那一项
words.core_image: 菜单上并排列着几行，每行都能点
examples: You have three options here.
Leaving early was not an option.
semantic_expansions: 选项：摆出来供挑的那一项
选择权：可以挑这件事本身。同一个'可挑之项'，一个指项一个指权

words.root_logic: option（选项）+ -al（…的）→ 属于可挑可不挑的 → 可选的
words.native_definition: not required; left to one's choice
words.core_concept: left to the chooser, not imposed – 挑不挑由你，不强加
words.core_image: 报名表上那一栏标着可不填，空着也能提交
examples: The insurance is optional.
Attendance at the talk is optional.
semantic_expansions: 可选的与非必需的：都是'挑不挑由你、不强加'——与 compulsory（被推着非做不可）正好构成一对

words.root_logic: ad-（朝向）+ opt（选择）→ 挑中并把它拿到自己这边 → 采用；把孩子挑来归入自家 → 收养
words.recall_hint: ad-（朝向）+ opt（选择）→ 挑中并把它拿到自己这边：可以是一套做法，也可以是一个孩子
words.origin: 拉丁语 adoptare：ad-（朝向）+ optare（选择）
words.native_definition: to start using a method or attitude, or to take a child into one's family
words.core_concept: choosing something and taking it as one's own – 挑中它并把它变成自己的
words.core_image: 从几套方案里挑一套，然后照它办事
examples: The committee adopted the new rules.
They adopted a boy from overseas.
semantic_expansions: 采用/采取：挑中一套做法并照它办
收养：挑中一个孩子并归入自家。同一个'挑中并纳为己有'，纳的是做法还是人

words.root_logic: civis（市民）+ -il（…的）→ 与市民相关的 → 公民的；引申为像市民之间那样有礼 → 客气的
words.recall_hint: civis（市民）+ -il → 与市民身份相关的；引申为像市民相处那样守礼、不动武
words.native_definition: relating to citizens and their affairs, not military or religious; also polite
words.core_concept: belonging to citizens rather than to force – 属于市民之事，而非武力或神权
words.core_image: 法庭里两方各请律师陈述，没人动手
examples: Civil rights were extended that decade.
He gave a civil but cool reply.
semantic_expansions: 公民的/民事的：属于市民之事，与军事、宗教相对
客气的：像市民相处那样守礼。同一个'市民之道'，一个说范畴一个说举止

words.root_logic: civil（公民的）+ -ian（人）→ 身份是市民而非军人的那个人 → 平民
words.origin: 拉丁语 civilis（公民的）← civis（市民）
words.native_definition: a person who is not a member of the armed forces or police
words.core_concept: one who stands as a citizen, not under arms – 以市民身份而非武装身份在场的人
words.core_image: 街上穿便装的人流，中间夹着几个穿制服的
examples: Most of the casualties were civilians.
He returned to civilian life after the war.
semantic_expansions: 平民与老百姓：都是'以市民身份而非武装身份在场的人'，中文一个正式一个口语

words.root_logic: civil（市民的）+ -ize（使成为）→ 使之进入市民那套秩序 → 使文明
words.native_definition: to bring a group to a more organized and developed way of life
words.core_concept: bringing into the order citizens live by – 使之进入市民赖以相处的那套秩序
words.core_image: 野地上先划出街道，再立起规矩，人开始按序而居
examples: Rome sought to civilize the provinces.
Schooling helped civilize public debate.
semantic_expansions: 使文明与教化：都是'使之进入市民相处的那套秩序'，一个偏整体一个偏个人

words.root_logic: civilize（使入市民秩序）+ -ation（名词）→ 那套秩序连同其成果 → 文明
words.native_definition: an advanced stage of human society, or such a society itself
words.core_concept: the order citizens build and what it produces – 市民建起的那套秩序及其成果
words.core_image: 城墙、水渠、市集、法典摆在同一张图上
examples: The exhibition covers ancient civilizations.
Writing was crucial to early civilization.
semantic_expansions: 文明：市民秩序及其成果
文明社会：处在那套秩序中的社会。同一个词根，一个指成就一个指共同体
